author: Emogling games
description_zh:
装备你的剑，与朋友一起对抗怪物吧！

《Sword Masters》是一款多人在线 MMO 游戏，玩家将穿梭于不同的世界，斩杀各种怪物。
description_en: Equip your sword and fight against monsters with your friends! Sword Masters is a multiplayer MMO game where players travel through worlds and slay monsters.
